advisories.title: Remove the unused Go contract mirror
advisories.body: The TypeScript technical specification introduces a documentation-only Go `CapabilityContext` with no consumer or source of truth. Keeping this parallel, partial representation makes the authorization contract look multi-language and creates a second shape that can drift from `StaffIdentity` without providing an implementation or verification benefit.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_techspec.md:207-216 declares a documentation-only Go struct → Improvement: removing the unconsumed parallel contract leaves the TypeScript interfaces as the single clear authorization reference → Fix: delete the explanatory paragraph and Go code block.

rg -n 'CapabilityContext|documentation-only Go struct|workflow-template compliance' .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access → the struct and its stated rationale have no other consumer in the task artifacts.

advisories.title: Synchronize the task index with its completed implementation
advisories.body: The task index still labels Tasks 02–05 as pending even though their described deliverables are present in the worktree. This makes the workflow's top-level status misleading and forces a reader to inspect implementation files to know which work remains.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_tasks.md:8-11 marks Tasks 02–05 as pending → Improvement: accurate status makes the task index usable for release tracking → Fix: update each status after its acceptance evidence is recorded.

app/admin/_actions/staff-actions.ts:27-62, app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:491-815, app/benfeitor/page.tsx:4, and app/form/page.tsx:4 → the account, issued-document, and canonical-route deliverables assigned to these tasks are implemented.
